thread:
**Issue #4067 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4067: Patch: a dungeon run refuses a curse taken twice, and a mini-boss dealt no relic rolls its replacement at its Gold floor
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Two small holes in the dungeon run's rules. Neither is reachable through today's screens or content, but both would be once the Campaign and the designer's relic list arrive. First, a run's start accepts the same curse listed many times, and every copy counts. A hand-edited run file that lists one curse 100,000 times scores about 10,000 times as much: a single step and then abandoning pays 1,000 Embers, four times the whole level ladder, and tops the "most curse points" board. The start screen's toggles cannot do this. But the Campaign will pay Embers and rank leaderboards from run files the server replays, so that replay has to refuse a repeated curse, as it already refuses a relic taken twice. Second, a mini-boss whose relic was not dealt when the map was made should reward a Gold-or-better relic or none, as the spec says. Today it can hand out a Bronze one.

## Why

- `crates/run/src/lib.rs:857-859`: `run_check_setup` refuses a repeated relic ("{id} is taken twice"). The curse loop at 881-885 only checks that each id exists. `run_curse_points` (1366-1373) sums every listed copy, `run_score` (1426) scales by it, and `fight.rs:175-179` applies each copy's fight effect to the enemy.
- The spec reads curses as distinct. §15.9: "Curses are tiers chosen at the start, like Ascension". R2922001: "Each curse taken changes the enemy's handicap once", and its own comment in `fight.rs` says "each curse taken once". But §15.3 only says "Curses: any of the content's", so distinctness is nowhere stated or enforced.
- Why it matters: §15.1 says that in the Campaign "the server folds a finished run's file before it pays", and `run_fold` (1571) checks the setup only through `run_create` and then `run_check_setup`. §15.10 has a "most curse points" leaderboard. Arithmetic with the placeholder content: `temp-curse-1` (1 point) listed 100,000 times, then one row (`RUN_SCORE_ROW` 10), gives 10 × (100 + 10 × 100,000) / 100 = 100,010 (`RUN_SCORE_CURSE_POINT_PERCENT` 10), which is 1,000 Embers at `RUN_SCORE_PER_EMBER` 100. The ladder `RUN_LEVEL_EMBERS` totals 250.
- Mini-boss: in `fight_won` (`lib.rs:1842-1851`), the "drop already held" arm rolls with `RUN_MINI_BOSS_DROP_TIER` and the `None` arm rolls with no floor. §15.7: "a drop already held, or none, is replaced by a roll at `RUN_ARTIFACT_PERCENT`, a mini-boss's replacement of `RUN_MINI_BOSS_DROP_TIER` or better ([[R3286000]]). There is none when no artifact is left to roll." `fight_node` (1047-1052) deals a mini-boss no drop exactly when no unheld Gold-or-better relic was left as the map was dealt, so the unfloored roll can only give a lower tier.
- Tests miss it: the R3286000 tests in `crates/run/src/tests.rs` (486-580) only reach the held arm. With the placeholder relics the `None` arm cannot happen: there are four obtainable Gold-or-better relics, and a start holds at most two within `RUN_STARTER_ARTIFACT_POINTS` (8). It becomes reachable when the designer's list (§15.13) has fewer of them.

## Proposal

1. `run_check_setup`: refuse a curse listed twice with "{id} is taken twice", worded as the relic refusal is, since the start screen shows refusals word for word.
2. `fight_won`: the `None` arm passes the same mini-boss floor as the held arm, and one comment covers both.
3. §15.3: "Curses: any of the content's, each at most once". Add a ruling note in the issue's block for that decision, since the spec did not make it (CLAUDE.md rule 3), with its paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`. The mini-boss test is named after R3286000.
4. Tests: a setup with a curse twice is refused by `run_check_setup`, `run_create` and `run_fold`. A content with no unheld Gold-or-better relic at the deal gives a won mini-boss no relic even with a lower relic open (a mini-boss always rolls: its `RUN_ARTIFACT_PERCENT` is 100).

## Where it lands

- `crates/run/src/lib.rs` (`run_check_setup`, `fight_won`), `crates/run/src/tests.rs`
- `spec/15-dungeon-run.md` §15.3 (§15.7 already states the floor), a new `spec/rulings/R<issue×1000>.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`; R3286000, R2922001

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `run_check_setup` refuses a setup that lists a curse twice, with a sentence naming the curse. `run_create` and `run_fold` refuse it too, and the state is unchanged.
- [ ] A setup with distinct curses is accepted as before, and its score and fight setup are unchanged (the existing curse tests pass untouched).
- [ ] A mini-boss dealt no drop and won rewards a relic of `RUN_MINI_BOSS_DROP_TIER` or better, or none, never a lower tier. The test fails on `main`.
- [ ] §15.3 states that curses are distinct, linked to the new ruling, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-run`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-run --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` pass.

## Size and risks

Small: about ten lines of code, three tests, a spec line and a ruling note. Medium difficulty. Risk: a run file already on a device that lists a curse twice would stop folding, but only a hand-edited file can hold one. The mini-boss change only affects a branch the shipped content never reaches, so no saved run folds differently. The web's start screen already sends distinct curses (`StartScreen.tsx` toggles them), so the client needs no change.
```
